name: Omnistant
description: An autonomous personal-context agent. It watches a camera feed, remembers where your things were last seen, and catches you at the door with what you're about to leave without. Google ADK and Gemini over an append-only Postgres log, live on Cloud Run — built solo in seven days on one rule: the model never sources a fact.

name: PMIE — Prediction Market Intelligence Engine
description: An agentic system for prediction markets. A Go MCP server exposes market data and tooling; a Python engine evaluates and orchestrates the agents acting on it.

name: Trippy
description: An agentic application for international travel.

name: MergeOracle
description: A CLI that analyzes GitHub issues and PRs, summarizes the conversation, suggests a fix, and drafts a response for you.
